description: This script generates a JSON description of the GN build environment for the ANGLE project, used to facilitate building Android.bp files for Android's Soong build system. It includes functions to retrieve and recursively load build dependencies based on GN labels, and outputs a JSON file with build info.

methods.name: get_json_description
methods.description: Retrieves and parses JSON build description for a given GN target.

methods.name: load_json_deps
methods.description: Recursively loads dependencies' JSON descriptions for a target.

methods.name: create_build_description
methods.description: Creates a JSON build description for specified targets by running GN.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, generates build description, and writes output file.
